''See also: [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Ancient [[Bow]] of the Soulseeker, also known as [[Eclipse]] and the sacred bow{{!}}Sacred Bow of the Soulseeker, is a powerful weapon capable of instantly killing a [[Monarch]]. It is characterized by its amethyst beams and the ability to release massive volleys of forged arrows. The weapon's [[binding]] is linked to a [[Dreadgod]] known as the [[Silent King]], and it was crafted using materials from that entity's body. The bow features a [[dragon]] head at its center and is described as having an overwhelming [[aura]]. While it is considered a unique item made of irreplaceable components, its physical form creates connections to [[Icons]], making it a tool intended for [[Mercy]] to master as she grows. It is noted for its immense Spiritual pressure{{!}}spiritual pressure and its capacity to copy arrow flurries.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] [[Bow]] is a unique, white-striped [[Dreadgod weapon]] crafted from irreplaceable components that possesses the ability to copy arrows. Though feared by [[Reigan Shen]], this heavy metaphysical object serves as one of [[Lindon]]'s weapons, though holding it imposes an extra burden upon him. The weapon is so powerful that [[Lindon]] considers using it, yet he eventually withdraws it after the [[oracle codex]] reveals [[Northstrider]] tucking it away. While the bow snarls in [[dream aura]] and carries Authority{{!}}authority that can affect [[Mercy]]'s [[madra channels]], [[Lindon]] ultimately decides to leave the item with [[Mercy]], who had previously controlled it.}}
